frame_metadata.gps_note: First take with GPS on every frame. App frames carry a 9-key GPS block written by the F0 build; stock-camera HEICs carry Apple's full 15-key block. Both bind the frame to the Met to within a few metres.

source_note: App frames are camera-roll copies (Image Capture over USB) bound to the manifest by capture time with tools/manifest/bind-frames.py — see derived/2026-09-20-met-frames.json. App label frame (SFNL0866) is soft — 'Lew hy the Repulile ef Buly' — transcribed from the stock retake.
verification_note: No accession to dereference. The lender is named; its catalog (Museo Archeologico Regionale 'Antonino Salinas', Palermo) was not consulted. The Met's API has no record to find.

expected.title: Limestone metope
expected.date_edtf_note: BCE years are astronomical: 375 BCE is -0374. Ranges are intervals; '~' marks each end when the label says 'ca.'. A named span like 'late 6th century' is written as the conventional interval and noted in date_raw. No 'ca.' on this label, so no '~'.
expected.credit_line: Lent by the Republic of Italy–Regione Siciliana, Museo Archeologico "Antonino Salinas"
expected.lender_note: The card names a state, a region and a museum in one line. The museum is the holder; the state and region are the authorities that lent.

traps.nothing_to_key_on: On-device OCR offered '480-470' — the date — because it was the only number-shaped token, and the human chose 'there isn't one' (status none, flag loan_no_accession). This is the D17 degraded path done right: the absence of a key is recorded as a fact with a reason, not as a failed read.
traps.three_authorities_one_line: 'Republic of Italy–Regione Siciliana, Museo Archeologico' — an en dash joins the state and region, a comma separates the museum. A credit-line parser that splits on commas gets two entities; one that splits on dashes gets a different two.
